comment: The Duel line on Larak Lot (gameplay 59): two rule bots hold both seats, the tour watches and presses Join, and the server puts it in line. Run with FRAGR_QA_MODE=duel, FRAGR_QA_BOTS=2 and FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/duel-queue.json.

states.name: duel_watch
states.note: Watching a full Duel: the plate offers the line and says the winner stays.

states.name: duel_in_line
states.note: Join pressed: the server lists this watcher first in line, and the plate says so with the key that leaves it.
